name: Macrocosm
description: The same grid at low density, so the inner doodle reads as a constellation rather than a texture.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @doodle(@grid: 6 / 100%; background: #0000; @random(0.28) { background: #000; border-radius: 50%; }); mask: @doodle(@grid: 6 / 100%; background: #0000; @random(0.28) { background: #000; border-radius: 50%; }); -webkit-mask-size: 100% 100%; mask-size: 100% 100%; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
